safePosition.tribalTip: JM Die standard: X20 Z20 is safe home for most lathe setups

roughTurning.example: G85 NTURN D.1 U.010 W.005 F.01

tribalKnowledge: Use M1 between tool changes for operator inspection
G50 S### must precede G96 for CSS safety
Return to X20 Z20 before every tool change

G40 cancel cutter comp before G80 cycle cancel

safeStartBlock.tribalTip: ALWAYS include full safe start at program start and after each M01

toolChange.tribalTip: G43 H# should match tool number, Z should be safe clearance

workOffsets.tribalTip: JM Die uses G54 for most jobs, G55 for fixture offsets

peckDrill.tribalTip: Q value = peck depth, typically 0.5-1x drill diameter

tap.tribalTip: Feed MUST equal RPM × pitch for rigid tapping

safeReturn.combined: G91 G28 Z0. then G28 X0. Y0.
safeReturn.tribalTip: Always return Z first to avoid crashes

coolant.tribalTip: M9 after G91 G28 Z0., not before

tribalKnowledge: Always use G20 (inch) at program start for JM Die
M01 after every tool for operator inspection
G91 G28 Z0. BEFORE M9 coolant off
G43 H# must match tool number
Peck depth Q should be 0.5-1x drill diameter
Tap feed F = RPM × pitch exactly

offsetVariables.tribalTip: H175 is master offset adjustment, individual H values decrease per pass

adaptiveControl.tribalTip: M91 for approach moves, M90 for cutting

wireControl.tribalTip: M20 threads wire through part, M82 starts wire travel

tankControl.tribalTip: Double M78 ensures full tank fill

flushControl.tribalTip: M80 after tank fill, before cutting

powerControl.tribalTip: M84 enables EDM power for cutting

cutSequence.tribalTip: E-code selects power settings, H selects offset, F is feed override

cutterComp.tribalTip: G42 for external cuts, G41 for internal, always G40 before threading

dwellForGlue.tribalTip: M01 with comment allows operator to glue slug for skim cuts

tribalKnowledge: Offset values decrease per pass (rough to finish)
M91 adaptive off for approach, M90 on for cutting
Double M78 for reliable tank fill
G42 for external contours, G41 for internal
Include M01 (Glue Stop) before skim passes for slug retention

crossControllerPatterns.safeStartPhilosophy: Cancel all modal states, establish known position
crossControllerPatterns.toolChangePhilosophy: Safe Z first, then XY, then new tool
crossControllerPatterns.coolantPhilosophy: Start after spindle, stop after Z retract
crossControllerPatterns.feedPhilosophy: Reduce feed for finishing, increase for roughing

machinePriorities: Okuma LB15II: Primary lathe for punches
Haas VF-2/VF-3: Primary mills for electrodes
Mitsubishi MV1200S: Primary wire EDM for die openings

lathe: Include G50 S### before any G96 CSS command
Use M1 between all tool changes
Include tool description in NAT## comment
mill: Full safe start: G0 G17 G40 G49 G80 G90
G91 G28 Z0 before coolant off
G20 at start for inch mode
Tool length comp G43 H# must match tool
wireEDM: Decreasing offset pattern: H1 > H2 > H3 > H4
M91 for approach, M90 for cutting
M01 glue stop before skim passes
